'''2022 Endor Grand Prix''' was a Players Committee major event in Seattle, Washington, 8–10 April 2022. [[Jeff Lavigne]] finished 1st in the Top 8.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-endor-grand-prix/</ref><ref name="wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/jeffrey-lavigne-wins-2022-endor-grand-prix/ Jeffrey Lavigne Wins 2022 Endor Grand Prix], starwarsccg.org (12 April 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20220412145512/https://www.starwarsccg.org/jeffrey-lavigne-wins-2022-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]</ref>
